sections.label: Summary
sections.text:
Overview
Dynamic technology executive with a robust focus on leading transformative IT initiatives, specializing in artificial intelligence, cloud solutions, and automation across diverse sectors. Aiming to leverage extensive experience in driving operational excellence and stakeholder engagement.
Profile Summary
Seasoned IT leader offering years of experience exceeding in the technology field, focusing on the oversight of extensive IT projects, especially in artificial intelligence, cloud transformation, and automation across multiple sectors. Emerging technology practitioner with experience
in Generative AI, LLMs, RAG architectures, enterprise chatbot development, and ML workflows (TensorFlow, Pandas, EDA), enabling scalable automation and data-driven decision support
Expertise
end-to-end Incident/Problem/Change Management, RCA, risk & controls, QMS compliance, and SLA/SLO-driven performance management ensuring resilient and predictable service operations.
in
ITIL-aligned
service
governance,
including
Proven Program & Portfolio Manager skilled at E2E delivery execution, financial forecasting, benefits realization, RAID governance, roadmap planning, and cross-functional orchestration across engineering, security, compliance, and business leadership.
Strong project management, implementation skills that have resulted in repeated success in guiding sizeable, cross-functional, multi-cultural & multi-geographical teams of over XX in the design and launch of leading-edge solutions and best practices.
Strong Value Stream and Business Operations leader with deep capability in backlog prioritization, resource & capacity planning, cost optimization, vendor/partner oversight, and continuous improvement to maximize operational throughput.
Agile delivery champion leveraging JIRA, Confluence, MS Project, and executive dashboarding to drive transparency, cadence discipline, and high-quality stakeholder communication.
Hands-on with cloud, application, and integration ecosystems, including AWS cloud migration, infrastructure coordination, Java/JavaScript, API interfaces, and deployment pipelines, enabling informed technical decision-making.
Proven capabilities in engaging with clients & top management for evolving strategic vision, driving change, infusing new ideas, implementing emerging technologies for the long run, and taking enterprise system performance & productivity to the next level.

Work Experience
JP Morgan Chase & Co. | Vice President - Program Manager | Oct 2022 - Present
Responsibilities:
Directed end-to-end delivery of enterprise technology programs, overseeing cross- functional development and support teams, program planning, budgeting, and executive-level KPI reporting.
Led agile backlog and multi-squad sprint governance, ensuring prioritization aligned to
business value, regulatory obligations, and platform resilience objectives.
Strengthened operational excellence by governing incidents, changes, and risks through
ITIL best practices, driving continuous stability and service hygiene improvements.
Managed multi-million-dollar value-stream financials, including forecasting, actuals
tracking, and budget stewardship to ensure optimal resource and cost alignment.
Collaborated with Finance, Audit, and Risk partners to uphold compliance across resource charging, vendor invoicing, and mandatory
security and control requirements. Implemented robust program governance frameworks, ensuring transparent delivery cadence, risk visibility, and alignment of engineering execution with strategic business outcomes.
AI transformation Implemented AI-driven anomaly detection to proactively identify data quality issues, cutting reconciliation time by
30%.
Key Highlights:
Successfully implemented a comprehensive AI automation initiative that resulted in a 12% increase in team productivity, significantly reducing
the need for manual processes and enhancing overall operational efficiency.
Elevated application availability to 99.9% by embedding SLO-driven monitoring, proactive alerting, and reliability-focused engineering
practices.
Reduced toil by 40% in RPA operations via targeted UiPath and AI automation Cut incident resolution time by 25% and reduced alert noise by 30% through targeted automation, intelligent triage, and data-driven
operational insights.
Achieved a 40% reduction in engineering toil by automating repetitive workflows and streamlining operational processes, significantly
increasing engineering productivity.
Developed and executed a strategic plan that improved stakeholder satisfaction scores by 30 %demonstrating a commitment to delivering
exceptional service and value to clients.
Larsen & Toubro Infotech | Associate Director - Program & Delivery Manager | Dec 2017 – Oct 2022
Responsibilities:
Directed large-scale AWS cloud migrations for 27+ enterprise applications, driving planning, dependency orchestration, performance
optimization, and post-migration stabilization.
Orchestrated end-to-end SDLC execution—development through production support—across globally distributed Agile and ITIL teams of
100+ FTE.
Championed a DevOps operating model, unifying engineering and operations to accelerate release velocity and reduce deployment failures. Built executive-ready portfolio governance through dynamic dashboards, RAG status reporting, RAID management, and enterprise change
calendars.
Oversaw portfolio operations, including SOW management, procurement, vendor invoicing, and rapid resource onboarding.
Key Highlights:
Cut cloud infrastructure spend by 20% by implementing intelligent right-sizing strategies and forward-looking capacity forecasts. Accelerated KYC/AML onboarding by 30% through targeted automation that streamlined verification workflows and eliminated manual
bottlenecks.
Delivered the Brexit transition program successfully, re-architecting reporting and settlement platforms to meet dual EU/UK regulatory
mandates without service disruption.
Boosted deployment success rates by 35% through CI/CD automation, enhanced change governance, and adoption of containerized release
patterns.
Reduced change failure rates by 25% by embedding automated code reviews, quality gates, and standardized controls within GitLab
pipelines.
Datamatics Global Services | Solution Architect | Mar 2017 – Dec 2017
Responsibilities:
Drove application design and solution architecture for large-scale enterprise initiatives, ensuring alignment with strategic business
objectives.
Partnered with cross-functional teams to capture requirements, conduct feasibility assessments, and translate findings into precise technical
specifications.
Architected end-to-end solutions spanning UI, business services, integration, and data layers to ensure scalable, secure, and high-
performance systems.
Key Highlights:
Improved system performance by 25% by redesigning core architecture and eliminating key scalability constraints.
Won major UNICEF project engagements by delivering compelling solution proposals, technical demonstrations, and value-driven
architecture recommendations.
Capgemini Pvt. Ltd. | Lead Developer & Onsite Coordinator | May 2011 – Mar 2017
Responsibilities:
Developed enterprise-grade Java applications while leading onsite–offshore coordination across delivery teams and client stakeholders to
ensure seamless execution.
Governed change, deployment, incident, and escalation processes across development and production environments to maintain stability
and compliance.
Elevated delivery quality by conducting structured code reviews, driving knowledge transfer sessions, and leading defect triage to accelerate
resolution and improve engineering rigor.
